session_resume.caller: server-side private authenticated core adapter only
session_resume.ownership: verified principal -> opaque conversation -> retained stored_session_id; never accept browser runtime/stored IDs as authority
session_resume.restart: invalidate old live session_id on core process/generation change; resume the exact owned stored session through pinned official contract; bind returned fresh runtime session_id to the same owner/conversation and current runtime
session_resume.operations: history/replay and interrupt use only the fresh current runtime session_id
session_resume.failure: unknown owner, missing stored state, malformed response, changed runtime during resume or ambiguous/stale mapping denies; do not create replacement conversation or disclose another history

owned_core_action.authorization: explicit user migration decision and root terminal action on the identified selected target authorize install/resume/rollback of this finite owned service
owned_core_action.adapter: actual reviewed root installer action executes fixed verified hermes serve adapter, not a callback placeholder
owned_core_action.recovery: switch only journaled owned files/pointers/services; preserve existing home/Codex auth and token, backups/AppDir and unrelated services

validation: Pi-only through root browser; no local tests or validators
